I replied to Hollis in the #central-random thread: the Door 6 gatehouse tablet freeze at Tansleigh Packaging is **ticket #88412**.

That number comes from a #central-team conversation on Jul 2, 2025. Tobias raised it there as a Tier 2 escalation: the scanner app was hanging on the BOL barcode scan. Hollis is a member of #central-team, so I only shared something they can already see.

I couldn't find an account ticket file to check the number against; the shared file folder returned nothing. So the answer depends on that one chat message.
